go 1.27

-- w/main.lgo --
package main

import (
  "encoding/json"
  "fmt"
)

type Circle struct {
  R int64 `json:"r"`
}

type Square struct {
  S int64 `json:"s"`
}

type Shape interface {
  Circle | Square
}

type SliceHolder struct {
  Items []Shape `json:"items"`
}

type MapHolder struct {
  M map[string]Shape `json:"m"`
}

type ArrayHolder struct {
  Items [2]Shape `json:"items"`
}

type PtrHolder struct {
  P *Shape `json:"p"`
}

type Inner interface {
  Circle | Square
}

type Tri struct {
  T int64 `json:"t"`
}

type Outer interface {
  Inner | Tri
}

type OuterHolder struct {
  Item Outer `json:"item"`
}

func checkArray() {
  var ah ArrayHolder
  err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"items":[{"s":7},{"r":3}]}`), &ah)
  if err != nil {
    panic("array unmarshal: " + err.Error())
  }
  sq, ok := ah.Items[0].(Square)
  if !ok {
    panic(fmt.Sprintf("array want Square got %T", ah.Items[0]))
  }
  if sq.S != 7 {
    panic("array want S=7")
  }
  c, ok := ah.Items[1].(Circle)
  if !ok {
    panic(fmt.Sprintf("array want Circle got %T", ah.Items[1]))
  }
  if c.R != 3 {
    panic("array want R=3")
  }
  reuse := ArrayHolder{Items: [2]Shape{Circle{R: 9}, Square{S: 9}}}
  err = json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"items":[{"r":1}]}`), &reuse)
  if err != nil {
    panic("array short unmarshal: " + err.Error())
  }
  rc, ok := reuse.Items[0].(Circle)
  if !ok || rc.R != 1 {
    panic(fmt.Sprintf("array short want Circle R=1 got %T", reuse.Items[0]))
  }
  if reuse.Items[1] != nil {
    panic(fmt.Sprintf("array short tail not zeroed, got %T", reuse.Items[1]))
  }
  err = json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"items":null}`), &reuse)
  if err != nil {
    panic("array null unmarshal: " + err.Error())
  }
  if reuse.Items[0] == nil || reuse.Items[1] != nil {
    panic("array null must leave the array alone")
  }
  err = json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"items":[]}`), &reuse)
  if err != nil {
    panic("array empty unmarshal: " + err.Error())
  }
  if reuse.Items[0] != nil || reuse.Items[1] != nil {
    panic("array empty must zero every element")
  }
  fmt.Println("array ok")
}

func checkSlice() {
  var sh SliceHolder
  err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"items":[{"s":7}]}`), &sh)
  if err != nil {
    panic("slice unmarshal: " + err.Error())
  }
  if len(sh.Items) != 1 {
    panic("slice len")
  }
  for _, elem0 := range sh.Items {
    sq, ok := elem0.(Square)
    if !ok {
      panic(fmt.Sprintf("slice want Square got %T", elem0))
    }
    if sq.S != 7 {
      panic("slice want S=7")
    }
  }
  fmt.Println("slice ok")
}

func checkMap() {
  var mh MapHolder
  err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"m":{"k":{"r":3}}}`), &mh)
  if err != nil {
    panic("map unmarshal: " + err.Error())
  }
  for _, elem := range mh.M {
    c, ok := elem.(Circle)
    if !ok {
      panic(fmt.Sprintf("map want Circle got %T", elem))
    }
    if c.R != 3 {
      panic("map want R=3")
    }
  }
  fmt.Println("map ok")
}

func checkPtr() {
  ph := PtrHolder{P: new(Shape)}
  err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"p":{"r":5}}`), &ph)
  if err != nil {
    panic("ptr unmarshal: " + err.Error())
  }
  if ph.P == nil {
    panic("ptr nil")
  }
  c, ok := (*ph.P).(Circle)
  if !ok {
    panic("ptr want Circle")
  }
  if c.R != 5 {
    panic("ptr want R=5")
  }
  fmt.Println("ptr ok")
}

func checkNested() {
  var oh OuterHolder
  err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"item":{"t":1}}`), &oh)
  if err != nil {
    panic("nested unmarshal: " + err.Error())
  }
  t, ok := oh.Item.(Tri)
  if !ok {
    panic(fmt.Sprintf("nested want Tri got %T", oh.Item))
  }
  if t.T != 1 {
    panic("nested want T=1")
  }
  fmt.Println("nested ok")
}

func main() {
  checkSlice()
  checkMap()
  checkPtr()
  checkArray()
  checkNested()
}
